numeric_derivations.V03A_cross_covariance_proof: E[e | storage history]=0 follows from conditional unbiasedness at every cue state and independent future noise; E[se]=E[s E[e|history]]=0. Translation invariance makes the conditional readout variance independent of cue state. Constant D, no drift and no boundaries give Var(s)=2DT.
numeric_derivations.V03B_normalization_derivation: With z=L sqrt(2DJ), dividing 2DL/3+1/(JL) by sqrt(2D/J) gives z/3+1/z. Dividing the ideal formula by the same variance scale gives coth(z).
